data.name: SECTOR LOCKDOWN
data.detailed_description:
Sector Lockdown is a high-intensity vehicle roguelite set in a world where every road becomes a trap and every sector closes behind you.
The global security system has flagged you as a high-priority threat. Police units, armored convoys, drones and experimental strike forces are deployed to intercept your every move.
Your only chance of survival is to keep driving, keep fighting, and keep upgrading your machine into a rolling weapon of destruction.

Key Features

Vehicle Roguelite Survival

Enter sectors filled with enemies, hazards and events. Each escape harder than the last.

Car Upgrades

Enhance your stats :
Might, Cooldown, Area, Armor, Speed, Magnet, Projectile Count and more.
Turn your car into a tank, a glass cannon, or a drifting death machine.

Massive Arsenal of Weapons

Equip rocket launchers, drones, electric fields, missiles, rotating saws, mines, air strikes and experimental tech.
Every weapon evolves into devastating forms as you level up.

Escalating Pursuit Levels

Sectors enter Lockdown mode as your danger level rises.
New enemy types spawn, blockades appear, and the pressure intensifies with every minute.

Active Abilities

Use shields, nitro systems, special weapon modules and more — each with its own cooldowns, effects and upgrade paths.

Every Failure is a New Start

Unlock new vehicles, weapons, upgrades and achievements as you push deeper into the Lockdown.

data.short_description: Sector Lockdown is a fast-paced vehicle roguelite where the entire world hunts you down. Fight through hostile sectors, upgrade your car, unleash powerful weapons, and survive escalating pursuit levels in a neon-drenched world with no safe roads.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo 2GHz+ or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
